DEMO SURAKSHA HEALTH INSURANCE CO. LTD.
Policy Schedule and Certificate of Insurance
(Demo document, not a real policy)

Policy Number: SURK/H/2026/00045678
Plan Name: Suraksha Family Floater Plus
Policy Holder: Mr. Rahul Sharma
Policy Period From: 01/04/2025   Policy Period To: 31/03/2026
Sum Insured: Rs. 5,00,000
Premium: Rs. 14,755 (inclusive of GST)

Key Coverage Terms
Room Rent: Up to Rs. 5,000 per day
Co-payment: 10% on every admissible claim
Deductible: Rs. 5,000 per claim
Initial Waiting Period: 30 days from the policy start date
Pre-existing Diseases Waiting Period: 36 months
Specific Disease Waiting Period: 24 months
Cashless Facility: Available at network hospitals

Exclusions
- Cosmetic or plastic surgery unless needed after an accident.
- Dental treatment, unless it needs hospitalisation.
- Injury or disease caused by war, nuclear risk or hazardous sports.
- Treatment taken outside India.
- Any treatment where hospitalisation is not needed
  for more than 24 hours.

Sub-limits
- Cataract surgery: Rs. 40,000 per eye
- Hernia, hysterectomy and piles: Rs. 60,000 per illness
- Knee replacement: 25% of the sum insured

Terms and Conditions
This document is a demo. The insurer alone decides a claim.
